title: Sign of a binary inner product
statement: For every natural number $n$ and vectors $x,y\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, the real sign encoding of their inner product modulo two equals the binary character evaluated at that inner product: $\operatorname{sign}(\langle x,y\rangle)=\chi(\langle x,y\rangle)$.
